scenario.name: board-a-5v-fused-link-drop
scenario.description: DC drop across the fused 5 V entry link's copper at 100 mA. SUBSTITUTIONS, stated: the host supply is an ideal 5 V source; the downstream demand is a 50 ohm resistor drawing 100 mA at 5 V. The fuse and diode are NOT modeled and nothing here claims them. 20 C is requested because the extracted copper model is fixed at the IEC 60028 resistivity reference; any other temperature would be flagged as not fully covered by condition coverage.

provenance.resistivity_source: IEC 60028 international annealed copper standard, 20 C
provenance.two_terminal_asserted_by: scenario author; verified on this board: 5V_FUSED carries exactly pads F1.2 and D1.2
